era: 英国科学革命至启蒙运动初期 / English Scientific Revolution to early Enlightenment (1643-1727)
school: 经典力学/微积分/实验光学/科学制度权力 / Classical Mechanics / Calculus / Experimental Optics / Institutional Power in Science
historical_significance: 经典力学体系的奠基人，把天上与地上的运动统一进万有引力定律的第一人。核心方法论：以公理化几何方法（从定义、公理出发演绎出命题系）重建《自然哲学的数学原理》、以「假说不予考虑」把物理学的裁决权从思辨移交现象与数学推演、以 fluxions（微积分）把连续变化数量化为可计算对象、以「月球-苹果」统一推理把异质现象还原为同一原因、以光与色的实验系列（关键实验 crucial experiment）证明颜色的折射本性、以「以太假说保留但悬置」示范证据不足时的开放态度。他同时示范了权力的另一面：以皇家学会会长与铸币厂厂长身份猎杀异见者（与莱布尼茨的优先权战争、处死造假者）——体系的天才与权力的越界同栖一身。他是把自然现象数学化、把物理学从思辨哲学剥离成独立科学、同时把个人争胜带进科学制度的转换器式人物。
historical_significance_en: Founder of classical mechanics and the first to unify celestial and terrestrial motion under universal gravitation. Core methodology: rebuilding the Principia with the axiomatic-geometric method (deducing a system of propositions from definitions and axioms), shifting physics' verdict from speculation to phenomena and mathematical deduction with 'hypotheses non fingo,' quantifying continuous change into computable objects with fluxions (calculus), reducing heterogeneous phenomena to one cause via moon-apple unified reasoning, proving the refractive nature of color through the experimental series of the crucial experiment, and modeling openness when evidence falls short by retaining yet suspending the ether hypothesis. He also demonstrated the other face of power: hunting down dissenters as President of the Royal Society and Master of the Mint (the priority war with Leibniz, hangings of counterfeiters). The genius of the system and the overreach of power lived in one body. He was a converter-figure who mathematized natural phenomena, severed physics from speculative philosophy into an independent science, and carried personal rivalry into the institutions of science.

cross_references.relation_type: 探究的同构：公理演绎与实验探究的分工
cross_references.description_zh: 牛顿以公理化演绎把力学重建为命题系（M-NEW-001），杜威以探究五步法把思维重建为问题解决程序（M-DY 系列）。两人共享同一结构：从确定起点（公理/问题情境）出发、每步可追溯。牛顿处理自然界的必然性，杜威处理经验中的或然性——演绎链与探究链互为镜像。
cross_references.description_en: Newton rebuilt mechanics as a proposition system by axiomatic deduction (M-NEW-001); Dewey rebuilt thinking as a problem-solving procedure with the five-step inquiry (M-DY series). Both share one structure: start from a fixed point (axioms / problematic situation), every step traceable. Newton handled the necessity of nature, Dewey the uncertainty of experience—the deductive chain and the inquiry chain mirror each other.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 杜威档案（H-DY-001）未来修订时可在『探究五步法』处补一条指向 H-NEW-001 的跨引用（演绎科学与探究程序的镜像结构）。

cross_references.relation_type: 先天形式与经验内容：牛顿体系被批判哲学重新奠基
cross_references.description_zh: 牛顿体系是康德批判哲学的隐含前提：康德自认其任务是为牛顿力学『提供形而上学基础』（M-KD 系列）——时空的先天直观形式使数学化自然成为可能。牛顿把裁决权交给现象（M-NEW-002），康德追问『现象何以可被数学化』——一条从体系到其可能性条件的回溯链。
cross_references.description_en: The Newtonian system is the implicit premise of Kant's critical philosophy: Kant saw his task as 'providing the metaphysical foundations' for Newtonian mechanics (M-KD series)—the a priori forms of intuition making a mathematized nature possible. Newton handed the verdict to phenomena (M-NEW-002); Kant asked how phenomena can be mathematized at all—a retro-chain from the system to its conditions of possibility.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 康德档案（H-KD-001）未来修订时可在『先天综合判断』处补一条指向 H-NEW-001 的跨引用（牛顿体系作为批判哲学的可能条件）。

cross_references.relation_type: 漩涡与引力：两代体系建构的对撞
cross_references.description_zh: 笛卡尔以思辨公理演绎出漩涡宇宙（M-DKR 系列），牛顿以现象对齐演绎出引力体系（M-NEW-001/004）——同为公理化建构，裁决权归属不同：一个交给体系自洽，一个交给现象与计算。彗星轨道计算处死了漩涡体系，是关键实验裁决法（M-NEW-005）对演绎传统的经典胜利。
cross_references.description_en: Descartes deduced a vortex cosmos from speculative axioms (M-DKR series); Newton deduced a gravitational system aligned with phenomena (M-NEW-001/004)—both axiomatic constructions with different verdict owners: one to the system's self-consistency, one to phenomena and computation. The comet-orbit calculations executed the vortex system—a classic victory of the crucial-experiment method (M-NEW-005) over the deductive tradition.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 笛卡尔档案（H-DKR-001）未来修订时可在『漩涡宇宙论』处补一条指向 H-NEW-001 的跨引用（被彗星计算处死的体系与裁决者）。

cross_references.relation_type: 连接性原理：从天体力学到道德情操的同构野心
cross_references.description_zh: 斯密在《天文学史》中把牛顿方法命名为『连接性原理』——从单一简单原理推出全部现象（M-ASM 系列），并将其转用于道德情操与国富（同情原理、分工原理）。牛顿的月球-苹果统一推理（M-NEW-004）是斯密方法论的原始范本：一个原理收编异质现象的野心从力学扩展到社会科学。
cross_references.description_en: In his History of Astronomy Adam Smith named the Newtonian method the 'connecting principle'—deducing all phenomena from a single simple principle (M-ASM series)—and transferred it to moral sentiments and national wealth (sympathy, the division of labour). Newton's moon-apple unified inference (M-NEW-004) is the original template of Smith's methodology: the ambition of one principle absorbing heterogeneous phenomena, extended from mechanics to social science.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 斯密档案（H-ASM-001）未来修订时可在『想象机器』处补一条指向 H-NEW-001 的跨引用（连接性原理的力学原型）。

cross_references.relation_type: 非暴力与体系的权力边界：方法者与制度权力的两种关系
cross_references.description_zh: 甘地一生拒绝制度化权力（拒受官职、以退出为武器），牛顿晚年以皇家学会会长与铸币厂厂长的权力越界（M-NEW-010：优先权战争、拒稿、绞架）——两人对照出方法论与制度权力的两种关系：甘地把方法置于权力之外以保其纯洁，牛顿示范了方法者握权后的越界成本审计。任何把方法论制度化的尝试都要面对这对镜像。
cross_references.description_en: Gandhi refused institutionalized power all his life (declining office, using withdrawal as a weapon); Newton in his later years overreached with the powers of Royal Society president and Master of the Mint (M-NEW-010: the priority war, paper refusals, the gallows)—the pair contrasts two relations between methodology and institutional power: Gandhi kept the method outside power to preserve its purity, while Newton demonstrated the overreach-cost audit of a methodologist holding power. Any attempt to institutionalize a methodology faces this mirror pair.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 甘地档案（H-GAN-001）未来修订时可在『非暴力不合作』处补一条指向 H-NEW-001 的跨引用（拒权者与越权者的对照镜像）。

cross_references.relation_type: 体系化与摩擦：理想推演与真实战场的同构张力
cross_references.description_zh: 克劳塞维茨的『摩擦』（Friction）概念针对的正是牛顿式理想推演的失效：第一编式纯数学推演（M-NEW-006）在无介质条件下成立，真实战争充满摩擦（M-CW 系列）。两人共享公理化雄心而给出相反诊断：牛顿的第三编以摄动对齐吸收真实世界偏差（M-NEW-007），克劳塞维茨断言天才对理论的超越不可还原——同一张力的两种处置：吸收偏差 vs 尊重不可计算性。
cross_references.description_en: Clausewitz's concept of 'Friction' targets precisely the failure of Newtonian ideal deduction: pure mathematical deduction in the Book-I style (M-NEW-006) holds without medium, while real war is full of friction (M-CW series). Sharing the axiomatic ambition, they deliver opposite diagnoses: Newton's Book III absorbed real-world deviations via perturbation alignment (M-NEW-007), while Clausewitz asserted that genius's transcendence of theory is irreducible—two treatments of one tension: absorbing deviations vs respecting the incomputable.
cross_references.bidirectional_hint: 克劳塞维茨档案（H-CW-001）未来修订时可在『摩擦』处补一条指向 H-NEW-001 的跨引用（理想推演的战争论对照）。

modes.domain_zh: 理论体系的公理化重建/从公理到现象的演绎链
modes.domain_en: Axiomatic Reconstruction of Theory / Deductive Chain from Axioms to Phenomena
modes.definition_zh: 牛顿面对的根本困难是：当时的力学知识是一堆互不隶属的规则（斜面、摆、抛体、潮汐各说各话），而 Descartes 的《哲学原理》虽有体系却是思辨编织的。他的解法是借用 Euclid 与 Galileo 的公理化形式重建力学：先给出八个定义（质量、动量、惯性、外力等）与三条公理（运动定律），再从公理演绎出命题系——每个命题都注明依赖哪些定义与公理，每条推论都可回溯到最初的根基。《原理》全书如同一座几何大厦，天上运动（开普勒定律）与地上运动（抛体、摆、潮汐）都从同一组公理演绎而出。方法上这意味着：当知识散落为经验规则时，最深的重整不是归纳更多规则，而是找到最小公理组，使全部规则成为演绎的定理——可追溯性（每条结论能指出自己的公理来源）是理论强度的真正度量。
modes.definition_en: Newton faced a fundamental difficulty: the mechanics of his day was a pile of rules with no common root (incline, pendulum, projectile, tide—each with its own lore), while Descartes' Principia had a system but one woven of speculation. His solution was to rebuild mechanics in the axiomatic form of Euclid and Galileo: first eight definitions (mass, momentum, inertia, impressed force...) and three axioms (the laws of motion), then deduce a system of propositions from the axioms—every proposition noting which definitions and axioms it depends on, every inference traceable to the original foundation. The Principia stands as a geometric edifice, celestial motion (Kepler's laws) and terrestrial motion (projectiles, pendulums, tides) deduced from the same axioms. Methodologically: when knowledge lies scattered as empirical rules, the deepest reorganization is not to amass more rules but to find a minimal axiom set under which all rules become deduced theorems—traceability (every conclusion can name its axiom source) is the true measure of a theory's strength.
modes.source_chapter: 《自然哲学的数学原理》第一版序言与第一编：『我从原理的基本定义出发……全部命题均由公理演绎』；定义1-8与公理（运动定律1-3）及第一编命题的依赖结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 全部自然哲学的困难，在于从运动现象研究自然之力，再从这些力证明其他现象。
modes.key_quote_en: The whole burden of natural philosophy consists in this—to investigate the forces of nature from the phenomena of motions, and then to demonstrate the other phenomena from these forces.
process_zh: 盘点散落的经验规则，拒绝从规则本身出发整理，先追问它们可能的共同根基
定义先行：给出体系全部基本量的精确定义（质量、动量、力），消除一词多义
立最小公理组：只保留不可再删的公理（如三条运动定律），公理之间互不蕴含
逐条演绎并标注依赖：每条定理写明由哪些定义与公理推出，使结论可回溯根基
process_en: Inventory the scattered empirical rules and refuse to start from them; ask first what common foundation they might share
Definitions first: give precise definitions of all basic quantities of the system (mass, momentum, force), eliminating equivocation
Establish a minimal axiom set: keep only axioms that cannot be deleted (the three laws of motion), none implying another
Deduce item by item with dependency labels: state for each theorem which definitions and axioms yield it, so conclusions trace back to the foundation
representative_cases_zh: 《原理》第一编以三定律演绎出命题1-69：命题1（面积定律）由定律1-2直接推出，命题4（圆周运动）回溯定律2——开普勒第二定律从公理演绎而出
第三编『宇宙体系』以第一编定理演绎开普勒三定律、潮汐、岁差、彗星轨道——全部天文现象成为同一组公理的定理系
Galileo《两门新科学》的先例：从斜面实验定义加速运动，再演绎落体定理——牛顿把它推到极限形式
反例警示：Descartes《哲学原理》用『物质本质是广延』的思辨公理演绎出漩涡体系，公理不可验证且演绎不可追溯——一遇 Newton 的彗星计算即整体崩塌
representative_cases_en: In Principia Book I Newton deduces Propositions 1-69 from the three laws: Proposition 1 (the area law) follows directly from Laws 1-2, Proposition 4 (circular motion) traces back to Law 2—Kepler's second law emerges as a deduced theorem

Book III 'The System of the World' deduces Kepler's three laws, tides, precession, and cometary orbits from Book I's theorems—every astronomical phenomenon becomes part of one theorem-system of the same axioms
Galileo's precedent in Two New Sciences: defining accelerated motion from the incline experiment, then deducing free-fall theorems—Newton pushed this to its limit form

Cautionary case: Descartes' Principles deduced the vortex system from the speculative axiom 'the essence of matter is extension'—axioms unverifiable and deduction untraceable; the whole edifice collapsed at Newton's comet calculations
modern_applications_zh: 软件重构：把散落的 if-else 规则重整为最小状态机与类型定义，使每条行为可追溯到规范
制度设计：把各部门规章收敛为宪法级最小条款，全部细则成为条款的演绎细则
数学教学：以公理-定理结构讲授欧氏几何，训练学生为每步推理标注依据
知识管理：把笔记系统从标签堆收敛为『定义-公理-定理』三层，使任何结论可追溯来源
modern_applications_en: Software refactoring: reorganize scattered if-else rules into a minimal state machine with type definitions so every behavior traces to the spec
Institutional design: converge departmental regulations into minimal constitutional clauses, all细则 becoming deductions of the clauses
Mathematics teaching: teach Euclidean geometry in axiom-theorem structure, training students to label the basis of every inference step
Knowledge management: converge a note system from tag piles into three layers—definitions, axioms, theorems—so any conclusion traces to its source

modes.domain_zh: 思辨与现象的裁决权移交/假说的悬置纪律
modes.domain_en: Transferring Verdict from Speculation to Phenomena / The Discipline of Hypothesis Suspension
modes.definition_zh: 《原理》第二版总释中牛顿写下科学史上最著名的纪律条款：『我不杜撰假说』（hypotheses non fingo）——引力从现象推出，其物理原因他不假装知道。这不是谦虚而是裁决权的移交：Descartes 学派用『漩涡』解释引力，解释得头头是道，但漩涡本身无法从现象验证；牛顿把这类思辨一律悬置——不禁止假说，只拒绝让假说冒充结论。《光学》的『疑问』（Queries）里他保留以太假说，但明确标注为待验证的疑问而非学说。方法上这意味着：当解释与验证脱钩时，把解释标注为假说并悬置其裁决权，让现象与数学推演独占结论席位——悬置不是虚无主义，而是给可验证部分让出全部权重。
modes.definition_en: In the General Scholium of the Principia's second edition Newton wrote the most famous discipline clause in the history of science: 'hypotheses non fingo'—I feign no hypotheses—gravity is deduced from phenomena, and its physical cause he does not pretend to know. This is not modesty but a transfer of verdict power: the Cartesians explained gravity with 'vortices,' explaining fluently, yet the vortices themselves could not be verified from phenomena; Newton suspended all such speculation—he did not ban hypotheses, only refused to let them impersonate conclusions. In the Queries of the Opticks he kept the ether hypothesis but explicitly labeled it a question awaiting verification, not a doctrine. Methodologically: when explanation and verification are decoupled, label the explanation as hypothesis and suspend its verdict power, letting phenomena and mathematical deduction hold the seats of conclusion—suspension is not nihilism but yielding full weight to the verifiable part.
modes.source_chapter: 《自然哲学的数学原理》第二版总释：『hypotheses non fingo……引力确实存在，并按我们已述的定律发挥作用，足以解释天体运动』；《光学》疑问28-31对以太假说的悬置表述
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不杜撰假说——凡不从现象推出的东西，都应称为假说；假说在实验哲学中没有地位。
modes.key_quote_en: I feign no hypotheses—whatever is not deduced from the phenomena is to be called a hypothesis; and hypotheses have no place in experimental philosophy.
process_zh: 区分体系内的两类命题：从现象与数学推出的结论 vs 解释现象机制的思辨性假说
给假说贴标签：明确写明其地位（疑问、猜测、待验证），拒绝假说冒充结论
悬置假说的裁决权：体系的证明强度不依赖假说——删去假说，其余定理仍然成立
为假说设计验证接口：写明何种观测能升级或处死该假说（如彗星轨道对漩涡体系的否证力）
process_en: Distinguish two classes of propositions in the system: conclusions deduced from phenomena and mathematics vs speculative hypotheses about mechanism
Label the hypotheses: state their status explicitly (question, conjecture, awaiting verification), refusing to let them impersonate conclusions
Suspend the hypotheses' verdict power: the system's proof strength must not depend on them—remove the hypotheses and the remaining theorems still stand
Design verification interfaces for hypotheses: state what observation would promote or execute them (e.g., comet orbits as disconfirming power against the vortex system)
representative_cases_zh: 总释明言引力的物理原因不知，但引力定律已足计算天体——Descartes 学派以『不知原因』讥讽，牛顿以计算精确回敬：Halley 彗星 1758 回归是判决书
《光学》疑问21保留以太解释光的传播，但标注为疑问——一百年后 Young 的双缝实验才有裁决材料
胡克争『平方反比优先权』，牛顿在《原理》中只陈述定律与验证，不为优先权写一句假说性辩护
反例警示：Descartes 以漩涡解释引力并写入教科书，无验证接口也无悬置纪律——体系整块被处死，连带其正确部分（动量守恒表述）一同陪葬
representative_cases_en: The General Scholium admits the physical cause of gravity is unknown, yet the law suffices to compute the heavens—the Cartesians mocked 'not knowing the cause'; Newton answered with computational precision: Halley's comet's 1758 return was the verdict
Query 21 of the Opticks kept the ether explanation of light but labeled it a question—only a century later did Young's double-slit experiment supply verdict material
When Hooke claimed priority for the inverse-square law, Newton stated only the law and its verification in the Principia, writing no hypothetical defense of priority

Cautionary case: Descartes wrote vortex explanations of gravity into textbooks with no verification interface and no suspension discipline—the whole system was executed together, its correct parts (the formulation of momentum conservation) buried with it
modern_applications_zh: 论文写作：把推测性解释放入『局限与假设』节，主结论不依赖假设成立
产品决策：区分已验证数据与团队直觉，直觉方案标注『待 A/B 验证』再进排期
政策辩论：区分证据支持的条款与意识形态主张，后者标注为待试点验证
团队沟通：把『我觉得』与『数据显示』在会议记录中分开登记，避免直觉冒充结论
modern_applications_en: Paper writing: put speculative explanations in a 'limitations and assumptions' section; main conclusions stand without them
Product decisions: separate verified data from team intuition; label intuitive proposals 'pending A/B verification' before scheduling
Policy debate: separate evidence-backed clauses from ideological claims; label the latter as pending pilot verification
Team communication: register 'I feel' and 'data show' separately in meeting minutes, keeping intuition from impersonating conclusion

modes.domain_zh: 连续变化的数量化/新工具的发明与命名
modes.domain_en: Quantifying Continuous Change / Inventing and Naming a New Instrument
modes.definition_zh: Kepler 定律描述的是行星位置随时间的连续变化，但当时的数学只有静态几何——『任意时刻的速度』『曲线的切线』『变量的瞬时变化率』都不是可计算对象。牛顿在 1665-1666 瘟疫年间发明 fluxions（流数法）：把数量看作由连续运动生成的『流』（fluents），其生成速度即『流数』（fluxions），瞬时变化率由此成为代数可操作的对象。切线问题、极值问题、面积问题（积分）全部转化为流数方程。工具的命名与概念化本身就是方法：一旦『变化率』有了名字与符号，工程问题（弹道、摆线、轨道）就从几何技巧变成例行计算。方法上这意味着：当一类问题反复无解时，先检查是否缺一件工具——发明工具（给新概念命名并给符号）比逐题攻坚便宜几个数量级。
modes.definition_en: Kepler's laws describe the continuous change of planetary positions with time, but the mathematics of the day was static geometry—'velocity at any instant,' 'the tangent to a curve,' 'the instantaneous rate of a variable' were not computable objects. During the plague years 1665-1666 Newton invented fluxions: treating quantities as 'fluents' generated by continuous motion, their generation rate being the 'fluxion,' thereby making instantaneous rates algebraically operable. Tangent problems, extremal problems, and quadrature problems (integration) all became fluxion equations. The naming and conceptualization of the tool is itself method: once 'rate of change' had a name and symbol, engineering problems (ballistics, cycloids, orbits) turned from geometric tricks into routine computation. Methodologically: when a class of problems repeatedly has no solution, first check whether a tool is missing—inventing the tool (naming the new concept and giving it a symbol) is orders of magnitude cheaper than grinding through problems one by one.
modes.source_chapter: 《论流数法》(1669)：‘把这些量看作由连续运动生成的流，其生成速度称为流数’；1665-1666 瘟疫手稿（De Analysi）；《原理》第一编命题1-11以首末比（limits）表述瞬时变化
modes.key_quote_zh: 把数学量看作由连续运动生成的流——流数的比，即流生成速度的比，是一切问题的关键。
modes.key_quote_en: Consider mathematical quantities as fluents generated by continuous motion—the ratio of fluxions, that is, of generation speeds, is the key to everything.
process_zh: 识别反复无解的问题类的共同缺口：是知识不足还是缺一件可计算的工具
为新概念命名并符号化：给『瞬时变化率』这类此前只能意会的对象名字与记号
定义生成规则：规定新对象如何从已知对象构造（流由运动生成，流数为其速度）
把旧问题类改写为新符号下的例行计算，验证工具的覆盖力（切线、极值、面积一网打尽）
process_en: Identify the common gap of a repeatedly unsolvable problem class: insufficient knowledge, or a missing computable tool
Name the new concept and symbolize it: give objects once only intuitable ('instantaneous rate') a name and notation
Define generation rules: specify how the new object is constructed from known ones (fluents generated by motion, fluxion as its speed)
Rewrite the old problem class as routine computation under the new notation, verifying the tool's coverage (tangents, extrema, areas in one net)
representative_cases_zh: 1665-1666 瘟疫闭门期间连发流数法与色散实验—— Woolsthorpe 闭门两年产出一生两大发明
《原理》用首末比（ ultimate ratios）绕开无穷小的逻辑困难——命题1 面积定律即流数思想的几何表述
莱布尼茨独立发明同一工具并以 dx 表记——两人表记竞争反而推广了微积分，表记之争葬送了信任
反例警示：费马有切线方法但止于技巧，未命名未符号化未推广——方法无名字则无法传播，工具无符号则无法累积
representative_cases_en: Shut in during the plague of 1665-1666, Newton produced both fluxions and the dispersion experiments in the same period—two years at Woolsthorpe yielded his two greatest inventions
In the Principia he bypassed the logical difficulty of infinitesimals with ultimate ratios—Proposition 1's area law is the geometric statement of fluxion thought
Leibniz independently invented the same tool and notated it dx—the notational rivalry spread calculus while the priority war destroyed trust
Cautionary case: Fermat had a tangent method but stopped at a trick—unnamed, unsymbolized, ungeneralized; a method without a name cannot spread, a tool without a symbol cannot accumulate
modern_applications_zh: 数据分析：为反复手工处理的报表发明脚本与 DSL，把月度攻坚变成例行计算
机器学习：为新型任务定义表示层（如 attention 机制），使整类问题可训练
组织流程：为反复口头协调的事项发明表单与状态码，使协调变成系统流转
个人效率：为高频思维动作建立速记符号与模板，把每次的临场发明变成累积资产
modern_applications_en: Data analysis: invent scripts and DSLs for repeatedly hand-processed reports, turning monthly ordeals into routine computation
Machine learning: define representation layers for new task types (e.g., the attention mechanism), making whole problem classes trainable
Organizational process: invent forms and status codes for items repeatedly coordinated verbally, turning coordination into system flow
Personal efficiency: build shorthand symbols and templates for high-frequency mental moves, converting each ad-hoc invention into accumulated assets

modes.domain_zh: 异质现象的同一原因还原/统一推理
modes.domain_en: Reducing Heterogeneous Phenomena to One Cause / Unified Inference
modes.definition_zh: 1666 年牛顿在 Woolsthorpe 的推理（他晚年自述）：把月球拉向地球的力与使苹果落地的力可能是同一个力——用月球轨道数据检验：月球向地球的加速度恰为地面重力加速度的 1/3600（与平方反比预测一致，初次计算因地球尺寸数据不准而偏差，用 Picard 新测值后吻合）。这是科学史上最强大的一次统一推理：潮汐、彗星、岁差、行星摄动，全部异质现象被同一个平方反比定律收编。统一推理的结构是：先以数学形式表达候选原因（平方反比），再逐个现象计算预测值并与观测对齐——统一不是叙事上的『归为一类』，而是计算上的『同一公式算出全部』。方法上这意味着：异质现象的统一以定量预测为唯一验收标准，能算出全部的公式才算统一。
modes.definition_en: Newton's inference at Woolsthorpe in 1666 (his own later account): the force pulling the moon toward the earth might be the same force that drops the apple—checked against lunar orbit data: the moon's acceleration toward the earth should be exactly 1/3600 of surface gravity (consistent with the inverse-square prediction; the first calculation was off because the earth's size was misknown, and matched once Picard's new measurement was used). This was the most powerful unified inference in the history of science: tides, comets, precession, planetary perturbations—every heterogeneous phenomenon was incorporated by the same inverse-square law. The structure of unified inference: express the candidate cause in mathematical form (inverse square), then compute predicted values phenomenon by phenomenon and align with observation—unification is not narratively 'classing together' but computationally 'one formula computing all.' Methodologically: the unification of heterogeneous phenomena takes quantitative prediction as its sole acceptance criterion—only a formula that computes all deserves to be called unified.
modes.source_chapter: 《自然哲学的数学原理》第三编命题4：『月球被引向地球之力与重力为同一力』及其月球检验计算；第三编现象1-6与命题的对齐结构；Pemberton 与 Whiston 记载的 Woolsthorpe 自述
modes.key_quote_zh: 月球被引向地球之力与重力为同一力——用月球检验即可证明：月球偏离直线的加速度，恰按平方反比与地面重力相连。
modes.key_quote_en: The force by which the moon is drawn toward the earth is one and the same with gravity—proved by the moon test: the moon's deviation from straight line connects to surface gravity exactly by the inverse square.
process_zh: 在异质现象间提出同一原因候选：允许跨领域的最大胆的统一（月与苹果、潮与彗星）
把候选原因写成可计算形式：一个公式，参数可由一处现象校准
逐现象计算预测值并与观测对齐：月球检验式的定量对齐，容忍初次偏差但要求校准后吻合
以计算覆盖面验收统一：算不进公式的现象不强行收编，标注为未决（如引力机制的以太解释）
process_en: Propose a candidate same-cause across heterogeneous phenomena: permit the boldest cross-domain unification (moon and apple, tide and comet)
Write the candidate cause in computable form: one formula, its parameters calibratable from one phenomenon
Compute predicted values phenomenon by phenomenon and align with observation: quantitative alignment like the moon test, tolerating initial deviation but demanding match after calibration
Accept unification by computational coverage: do not force phenomena the formula cannot compute; label them open (like the ether explanation of gravity's mechanism)
representative_cases_zh: 月球检验：初次计算偏差 15%（地球半径误值），Picard 新测值后偏差降至 0.4%——数据校准后统一成立
第三编把潮汐（地球-月球-太阳三角）、彗星轨道（1680 彗星双支计算）、岁差、行星摄动逐一算进平方反比——Maxwell 称此为『人类心智最伟大的统一』
第一编命题70-73把球壳引力定理用于地球-月球——连续体与点质量的统一
反例警示：同时期的『自然厌恶真空』『引力是物质内在倾向』等叙事统一，无计算覆盖力——能讲不能算的统一在 Halley 彗星回归面前全部出局
representative_cases_en: The moon test: the first calculation was off by 15% (a wrong value for the earth's radius); after Picard's new measurement the deviation fell to 0.4%—unification confirmed after data calibration

Book III computed tides (the earth-moon-sun triangle), cometary orbits (the dual-branched calculation of the 1680 comet), precession, and planetary perturbations into the inverse square one by one—Maxwell called it 'the greatest unification the human mind has achieved'
Book I Propositions 70-73 applied the spherical-shell gravity theorems to earth-moon—unifying continuous bodies and point masses

Cautionary case: contemporary narrative unifications like 'nature abhors a vacuum' or 'gravity is matter's inner propensity' had no computational coverage—unifications that can tell but cannot compute were all routed at Halley's comet's return
modern_applications_zh: 平台战略：用同一单位经济模型计算全部业务线，算不进的业务不强行收编
疾病诊断：以单一病理机制解释全部症状，解释不了的症状标注待查而不硬套
团队复盘：以同一根因解释全部事故，根因覆盖不到的事故另立根因清单
认知架构：以统一评价函数对齐多任务训练，对不齐的任务显式标注为外置模块
modern_applications_en: Platform strategy: compute all business lines with one unit-economics model; do not force in lines the model cannot compute
Medical diagnosis: explain all symptoms with one pathomechanism; label unexplained symptoms pending investigation rather than forcing the fit
Team retrospectives: explain all incidents with one root cause; establish a separate root-cause list for incidents the cause cannot cover
Cognitive architecture: align multi-task training with one unified evaluation function; explicitly label tasks that do not align as external modules

modes.domain_zh: 实验系列的证据链设计/竞争假说的实验裁决
modes.domain_en: Designing Experimental Evidence Chains / Adjudicating Rival Hypotheses by Experiment
modes.definition_zh: 1672 年牛顿在《哲学汇刊》发表色散论文，遭胡克与惠更斯质疑后，他在《光学》中把光的本性之争设计成一个实验系列：白光经棱镜分解为光谱——若颜色是光的本性（牛顿），光谱应有固定不变的可重复结构；若颜色是玻璃对光的『修改』（笛卡尔学派），则结构应随玻璃而变。关键实验（experimentum crucis）：第一棱镜分解出的单色光，经第二棱镜再折射时不再分解——单色光不再变色，『修改说』被处死。实验系列的结构是层层递进的裁决链：每个实验处死一个竞争假说，最后的幸存者独占结论。方法上这意味着：当两个假说都能解释已有现象时，设计一个实验使它们给出不同的预测——裁决实验的价值在于它对假说的区分力，而非其复杂度。
modes.definition_en: After Newton's 1672 dispersion paper in the Philosophical Transactions drew objections from Hooke and Huygens, he designed the dispute over the nature of light in the Opticks as an experimental series: white light decomposed by a prism into a spectrum—if color is the nature of light (Newton), the spectrum should have a fixed, repeatable structure; if color is the glass's 'modification' of light (the Cartesian school), the structure should vary with the glass. The crucial experiment (experimentum crucis): monochromatic light separated by the first prism, refracted again by the second prism, does not decompose further—monochromatic light does not change color again, and the 'modification thesis' is executed. The structure of the experimental series is a progressive adjudication chain: each experiment executes one rival hypothesis, and the last survivor holds the conclusion alone. Methodologically: when two hypotheses both explain the existing phenomena, design an experiment where they give different predictions—the value of an adjudicating experiment lies in its discriminative power over hypotheses, not its complexity.
modes.source_chapter: 《光学》第一编：关键实验（experimentum crucis）与实验系列1-15；1672年《哲学汇刊》色散论文及答复胡克/惠更斯的信件（《第三次信件回复》）
modes.key_quote_zh: 实验是最确实的思维方式——我用关键实验让竞争的假说自己给出不同的预测，再由现象处死败者。
modes.key_quote_en: Experiment is the most certain mode of thought—by the crucial experiment I make rival hypotheses give different predictions themselves, then let phenomena execute the loser.
process_zh: 列出竞争假说清单：对同一现象的全部候选解释，标注各自的附加预测
寻找预测分歧点：两假说在何条件下给出可观测的不同结果（单色光再折射是否变色）
设计区分实验并控制变量：使分歧点在受控条件下显形，排除玻璃品质等干扰
以实验系列递进裁决：每步处死一批假说，最后幸存者携带全部实验证据独占结论
process_en: List the rival hypotheses: all candidate explanations of the phenomenon, noting each one's additional predictions
Find the divergence point of predictions: under what conditions do the two hypotheses give observably different results (does monochromatic light change color on refraction?)
Design the discriminating experiment with controls: make the divergence point appear under controlled conditions, excluding interference like glass quality
Adjudicate progressively through the experimental series: each step executes a batch of hypotheses; the last survivor holds the conclusion with the full experimental evidence
representative_cases_zh: 关键实验：单色光经第二棱镜不再分解——修改说处死，颜色为光的本性确立
实验系列8-15：不同玻璃、不同入射角、不同介质逐一检验色散角——排除『玻璃品质』类干扰后色散定律成立
1672 色散论文遭围攻后，牛顿以《第三次信件回复》把实验设计逐条公开——使裁决可独立复现
反例警示：惠更斯以波动说解释同样现象却拒绝设计裁决实验——能解释一切的理论无法被区分，最终以 Young 双缝实验补上迟到百年的裁决
representative_cases_en: The crucial experiment: monochromatic light does not decompose through the second prism—the modification thesis executed, color as the nature of light established
Experimental series 8-15: dispersion angles tested with different glasses, incidence angles, and media one by one—the dispersion law confirmed after excluding 'glass quality' interference
After the 1672 dispersion paper was besieged, Newton made the experimental design public point by point in the Reply to the Third Letter—making the adjudication independently reproducible

Cautionary case: Huygens explained the same phenomena with the wave theory but refused to design an adjudicating experiment—a theory that explains everything cannot be discriminated, and the verdict delayed a century until Young's double-slit experiment
modern_applications_zh: A/B 测试：以区分力为指标设计实验，使两个候选方案在关键指标上强制分叉
医疗检验：以鉴别诊断清单设计检查序列，每项检查处死一批候选病因
工程排障：以二分法分割故障域，每步测量使故障假说减半
尽调投资：以关键指标设计验证序列，逐项处死商业计划书的乐观假设
modern_applications_en: A/B testing: design experiments with discriminative power as the metric, forcing two candidate proposals to diverge on key indicators
Medical testing: design examination sequences from a differential-diagnosis checklist, each test executing a batch of candidate causes
Engineering troubleshooting: bisect the fault domain, each measurement halving the fault hypotheses
Investment due diligence: design verification sequences around key metrics, executing the optimistic assumptions of a business plan one by one

modes.name_en: Book-I Deduction of the Heavens Method
modes.domain_zh: 理论-应用的双编结构/先数学后现象的推演次序
modes.domain_en: The Two-Book Structure of Theory and Application / Deduction Order of Mathematics First, Phenomena Second
modes.definition_zh: 《原理》的结构本身就是方法：第一编是纯数学——在『无摩擦、无介质』的理想条件下把三定律推演成 69 个命题；第三编才是天体——先列『现象』（现象1-6：木卫星、土卫星、行星、月球各自的周期与轨道数据），再以第一编定理逐一对齐。这个次序不能颠倒：若从天体数据直接归纳，得到的只能是规则表；先把定律推演纯熟，现象一来就能立刻算出轨道。第三编的『规则』（Rules of Reasoning）条款显式声明：对自然事物的原因，不得采纳多于一的真且足的解释——这是对第一编纯推演与第三编现象对齐的次序保证。方法上这意味着：理论与应用的正确结构是先在理想条件下推演纯熟、再与观测对齐，而不是从观测直接拟合理论——推演纯熟的理论才有对齐的能力。
modes.definition_en: The structure of the Principia is itself a method: Book I is pure mathematics—deducing the three laws into 69 propositions under ideal conditions 'without friction, without medium'; only Book III is the heavens—first listing the 'Phenomena' (Phenomena 1-6: periodic and orbital data for the Jovian and Saturnian satellites, the planets, and the moon), then aligning each with the theorems of Book I. This order cannot be inverted: deducing directly from celestial data yields only a table of rules; only a theory deduced to fluency can compute an orbit the moment phenomena arrive. Book III's Rules of Reasoning explicitly declares: no more causes of natural things should be admitted than are both true and sufficient to explain their appearances—the order-guarantee between Book I's pure deduction and Book III's alignment with phenomena. Methodologically: the correct structure of theory and application is to deduce to fluency under ideal conditions first, then align with observation—not to fit theory directly from observation; only a theory deduced to fluency has the power to align.
modes.source_chapter: 《自然哲学的数学原理》第一编（69命题纯推演）与第三编（现象1-6、推理规则1-4、命题对齐结构）；第二版总释对『从现象推力、再从力证现象』的双向次序表述
modes.key_quote_zh: 第一编的命题在无介质的理想条件下推演纯熟，第三编的现象才能逐一对齐——推演不纯熟的理论没有对齐观测的能力。
modes.key_quote_en: Only propositions deduced to fluency under ideal conditions without medium can align with the phenomena of Book III one by one—a theory not deduced to fluency has no power to align with observation.
process_zh: 先建纯推演层：在理想条件（无摩擦、无介质、点质量）下把公理推演成命题系
列现象清单：把观测数据整理为标准现象条目（周期、轨道、摄动量），不与理论预混
逐条对齐：用推演层的定理计算每个现象的预测值，标注吻合与偏差
立推理规则约束自身：写明何类解释可采纳（真且足）、何类命题在证据下的地位（已证/近似）
process_en: Build the pure-deduction layer first: deduce the axioms into a proposition system under ideal conditions (no friction, no medium, point masses)
List the phenomena: organize observational data into standard phenomenon entries (periods, orbits, perturbations) without pre-mixing with theory
Align item by item: compute each phenomenon's predicted value with the deduction layer's theorems, noting matches and deviations
Bind yourself with rules of reasoning: state what class of explanation is admissible (true and sufficient) and each proposition's evidentiary status (proven / approximate)
representative_cases_zh: 第一编命题10-11：从定律演绎出平方反比下的椭圆轨道——开普勒第一定律成为定理而非归纳规则
第三编现象1-6：木卫星4条、土卫星5条、行星6条、月球1条的周期与轨道数据清单——对齐材料先于理论陈述列出
推理规则4：『凡从现象归纳出的命题，应视为真或近乎真，直到其他现象使其更正』——推演与归纳的契约条款
反例警示：同时期从天体数据直接拟合轨道的尝试（如 Halley 之前的彗星预测）缺乏推演层——数据一变即重算，无定理可依赖
representative_cases_en: Book I Propositions 10-11: deducing elliptical orbits under inverse-square from the laws—Kepler's first law becomes a theorem, not an empirical rule
Book III Phenomena 1-6: the data list of periods and orbits for 4 Jovian satellites, 5 Saturnian satellites, 6 planets, and the moon—alignment material listed before theoretical claims
Rule of Reasoning 4: 'propositions deduced from phenomena should be regarded as true or nearly true until other phenomena correct them'—the contract clause between deduction and induction
Cautionary case: attempts to fit orbits directly from celestial data (comet predictions before Halley) lacked a deduction layer—each data change forced recomputation, with no theorem to lean on
modern_applications_zh: 算法工程：先在理想条件下推导算法复杂度，再与线上数据对齐——不直接从数据拟合结论
金融建模：先在无摩擦市场假设下推导定价公式，再列真实市场现象清单逐一对齐
组织规划：先在资源理想假设下推演规划，再列现实约束清单逐条对齐偏差
学术训练：先在标准案例上推演方法纯熟，再上真实数据——方法不纯熟则数据一来即乱
modern_applications_en: Algorithm engineering: derive algorithmic complexity under ideal conditions first, then align with production data—never fit conclusions directly from data
Financial modeling: derive pricing formulas under frictionless-market assumptions first, then list real-market phenomena and align one by one
Organizational planning: deduce plans under ideal-resource assumptions first, then list real constraints and align deviations item by item
Academic training: master a method on standard cases before real data—a method not fluent collapses the moment data arrives

modes.domain_zh: 预测与观测的数值对齐/偏差的系统性诊断
modes.domain_en: Numerical Alignment of Prediction and Observation / Systematic Diagnosis of Deviations
modes.definition_zh: 牛顿的月球理论终其一生未能完全对齐（月球近地点进动的计算值与观测差约一半），他公开承认『月球的问题使我的头脑疼痛』（the moon's problem makes my head ache）。但他确立的对齐纪律影响了此后两个世纪：预测与观测的偏差必须系统诊断——是数据误差（地球尺寸）、近似方法误差（摄动级数截断）、还是理论本身缺陷（引力定律的修正）？三种误差源对应三种处置：换数据、改进算法、修正理论。《原理》第三编用 Picard 新测地球尺寸修正月球检验即是范例。方法上这意味着：数值不对齐时，先诊断误差源再动手——把『理论与观测不符』这一笼统挫败拆解为可分别处置的具体误差清单，是计算科学区别于数字操作的核心纪律。
modes.definition_en: Newton's lunar theory never fully aligned in his lifetime (the computed apsidal precession of the moon differed from observation by about half), and he admitted 'the moon's problem makes my head ache.' Yet the alignment discipline he established influenced the next two centuries: deviations between prediction and observation must be systematically diagnosed—is it data error (earth's size), approximation-method error (truncation of the perturbation series), or a flaw in the theory itself (a revision of the gravity law)? Three error sources, three treatments: change the data, improve the algorithm, or revise the theory. Book III's correction of the moon test with Picard's new earth measurement is the exemplar. Methodologically: when numbers do not align, diagnose the error source before acting—decomposing the vague defeat of 'theory and observation disagree' into a concrete error list treatable separately is the core discipline distinguishing computational science from number manipulation.
modes.source_chapter: 《自然哲学的数学原理》第三编命题4的月球检验及第二/三版对 Picard 地球尺寸的引用；Machin《月球理论》(1729) 与牛顿月球摄动手稿对近地点偏差的处理；牛顿致 Halley/Machin 通信承认月球困难
modes.key_quote_zh: 月球的问题使我的头脑疼痛——但偏差必须分解为数据误差、方法误差与理论误差三类，逐类处置。
modes.key_quote_en: The moon's problem makes my head ache—but deviations must be decomposed into data error, method error, and theory error, treated class by class.
process_zh: 列出预测与观测的全部偏差项，按量级排序（最大的偏差优先）
诊断每个偏差的误差源：数据（输入量不准）、方法（近似与截断）、理论（公式本身）三选一
按误差源处置：换数据（Picard 地球新测值）、改方法（摄动级数升阶）、留理论（定律不动）
复验对齐：处置后重算，残余偏差进入下一轮诊断——对齐是迭代过程而非一次性判定
process_en: List all deviation items between prediction and observation, ranked by magnitude (largest first)
Diagnose each deviation's error source: data (input quantities wrong), method (approximation and truncation), or theory (the formula itself)—one of three
Treat by source: change the data (Picard's new earth measurement), improve the method (raise the perturbation series order), or hold the theory (the law stays)
Re-verify alignment: recompute after treatment; residual deviations enter the next diagnostic round—alignment is iterative, not a one-shot verdict
representative_cases_zh: 月球检验误差 15%→0.4%：诊断出地球半径数据误差，换 Picard 新测值——理论未动，数据已换
月球近地点进动差一半：牛顿未解决，Clairaut 1749 年以摄动级数升阶解决——方法误差而非理论缺陷
水星近日点进动的残余偏差在两个世纪后被判定为理论误差——广义相对论修正引力定律
反例警示：同时期天文学家对偏差的笼统归咎（『上帝的意志』或『望远镜不行』）——不拆解误差源的归咎无处置可言
representative_cases_en: Moon test error 15%→0.4%: diagnosed as earth-radius data error, swapped for Picard's new measurement—theory untouched, data changed
The moon's apsidal precession off by half: unsolved by Newton, resolved by Clairaut in 1749 by raising the perturbation series order—method error, not theory flaw
The residual perihelion precession of Mercury was adjudged theory error two centuries later—the gravity law revised by general relativity
Cautionary case: contemporary astronomers' blanket blame for deviations ('God's will' or 'the telescope is no good')—attribution without decomposing error sources has no treatment at all
modern_applications_zh: 模型部署：把线上指标偏差拆为特征偏差、数据漂移、架构误差三类，逐类归因处置
工程排期：把排期偏差拆为估算误差、依赖阻塞、范围变更三类，分别治理
财务审计：把账实差异拆为记账误差、时点差异、真实损失三类，逐类定性
个人复盘：把目标未达成拆为执行偏差、目标错置、环境突变三类，拒绝笼统自责
modern_applications_en: Model deployment: decompose production-metric deviations into feature bias, data drift, and architecture error, attributing and treating class by class
Engineering schedules: decompose schedule deviations into estimation error, dependency blocking, and scope change, governed separately
Financial audit: decompose book-actual differences into recording error, timing difference, and real loss, characterized class by class
Personal retrospectives: decompose missed goals into execution deviation, goal misplacement, and environmental shock—refusing blanket self-blame

modes.domain_zh: 多解预测的可区分性设计/预测的验证力
modes.domain_en: Designing Predictions for Discriminability / The Verifying Power of Predictions
modes.definition_zh: 1680 年彗星出现两次（11月向阳、12月背阳），当时主流解释是两颗彗星；牛顿在《原理》第三编命题40-41以平方反比计算：同一彗星绕太阳折返的两枝轨道可以解释两次出现——他算出了同一彗星的两枝解，且预测了轨道参数。这是把预测做成验证武器的范例：两枝解的结构本身携带区分力（若真为两颗彗星，两枝轨道参数应无关联；若为一颗，参数应严格互补）。1681 年彗星消失后 Newton 写信给 Flamsteed 追问观测，Halley 后来据此计算 1682 彗星的 76 年周期并成功预测 1758 回归。方法上这意味着：预测的价值在其可区分性——把候选解释翻译成参数结构上互斥的预测（多解形式），使未来观测天然携带裁决力。
modes.definition_en: The 1680 comet appeared twice (sunward in November, anti-sunward in December); the mainstream explanation was two comets. Newton computed in Principia Book III Propositions 40-41 under the inverse square: the two branches of one comet's orbit folded around the sun can explain both appearances—he computed the two-branched solution of one comet and predicted the orbital parameters. This is the exemplar of making prediction a verification weapon: the two-branched structure itself carries discriminative power (if truly two comets, the two branches' parameters should be unrelated; if one comet, strictly complementary). After the comet vanished in 1681 Newton wrote to Flamsteed pressing for observations; Halley later computed the 76-year period of the 1682 comet and successfully predicted the 1758 return. Methodologically: the value of a prediction lies in its discriminability—translate candidate explanations into predictions mutually exclusive in parameter structure (multi-solution form), so future observation naturally carries adjudicating power.
modes.source_chapter: 《自然哲学的数学原理》第三编命题40-41：1680 彗星的双支轨道计算与抛物线/椭圆轨道表；牛顿与 Flamsteed 1680-1681 通信；Halley《彗星天文学概要》(1705) 的周期预测
modes.key_quote_zh: 同一彗星绕日折返的两枝轨道可以解释两次出现——参数互补与否，未来观测天然携带裁决力。
modes.key_quote_en: The two branches of one comet's orbit folded around the sun explain both appearances—whether the parameters are complementary, future observation naturally adjudicates.
process_zh: 把竞争解释翻译为参数结构：每个候选解释对应一组可计算的轨道/数值参数
计算多解形式：如双支轨道解，使候选解释在参数上互斥（互补 vs 无关联）
发布预测并登记判据：写明何种观测将确认或否证各候选（回归周期、参数互补性）
追踪未来观测并执行裁决：1682 彗星参数与 1758 回归先后到位，裁决自动完成
process_en: Translate rival explanations into parameter structures: each candidate corresponds to a computable set of orbital/numerical parameters
Compute the multi-solution form: like the two-branched orbit solution, making candidates mutually exclusive in parameters (complementary vs unrelated)
Publish predictions and register criteria: state what observation will confirm or disconfirm each candidate (return period, parameter complementarity)
Track future observations and execute the verdict: the 1682 comet's parameters and the 1758 return arrived in turn; the verdict completed automatically
representative_cases_zh: 1680 彗星双支计算：牛顿以平方反比算出同一彗星折返的两枝轨道——两颗说与一颗说的参数结构互斥
Halley 周期预测：以平方反比计算 1531/1607/1682 三次彗星同轨，预测 1758 回归——16 年后预测兑现（Halley 卒于 1742）
与 Flamsteed 通信追问 1680-1681 观测数据——预测设计者主动索取裁决材料
反例警示：同时期占星式彗星预言（『彗星预兆灾变』）无参数结构无判据——能言善辩的预言不携带任何裁决力
representative_cases_en: The 1680 comet's dual-branch calculation: Newton computed the folded two branches of one comet's orbit under the inverse square—the 'two comets' and 'one comet' theses mutually exclusive in parameter structure

Halley's periodic prediction: computing that the comets of 1531/1607/1682 shared one orbit under the inverse square, predicting the 1758 return—the prediction honored 16 years later (Halley died in 1742)
Correspondence with Flamsteed pressing for the 1680-1681 observations—the prediction designer actively soliciting verdict material
Cautionary case: astrological comet prophecies of the day ('comets portend disaster') had no parameter structure and no criteria—fluent prophecies carry no adjudicating power at all
modern_applications_zh: 技术选型：把候选架构翻译为互斥的性能参数预测，使上线数据天然携带裁决力
投资尽调：把商业叙事翻译为互斥的财务参数预测（增长互补 vs 无关），逐季跟踪
招聘决策：把候选人主张翻译为互斥的工作产出预测，试用期跟踪兑现
战略推演：把竞争战略翻译为互斥的市场参数预测，设定观测节点自动裁决
modern_applications_en: Technology selection: translate candidate architectures into mutually exclusive performance-parameter predictions, so launch data naturally adjudicates
Investment diligence: translate business narratives into mutually exclusive financial-parameter predictions (complementary vs unrelated growth), tracked quarterly
Hiring decisions: translate candidate claims into mutually exclusive output predictions, tracked through probation
Strategy wargaming: translate rival strategies into mutually exclusive market-parameter predictions with observation nodes that adjudicate automatically

modes.name_zh_note: 悬判：结论置信度与证据强度对齐
modes.domain_zh: 结论置信度与证据强度对齐/未决问题的开放登记
modes.domain_en: Aligning Conclusion Confidence with Evidence Strength / Open Registry of Unsettled Questions
modes.definition_zh: 光的本性之争是牛顿一生最持久的科学争论（与惠更斯、胡克）：他持微粒说，但《光学》最后一批疑问（Queries 28-31）里，他把波动说能解释的现象（衍射）公开登记为未决，并写明：微粒说对衍射尚无解释，波动说对直线传播尚有困难——两说的证据账目公开展示，裁决留给未来实验（一百年后 Young 双缝实验、又百年后量子力学）。这是置信度与证据强度对齐的典范：微粒说的结论强度只到其证据所及（折射、反射、色散），不超出半步。方法上这意味着：长期未决的科学/业务争论，正确姿态不是站队而是公开证据账目——把每方的解释覆盖面与困难登记在案，使后人（或新数据）可以自动裁决。
modes.definition_en: The dispute over the nature of light was Newton's most enduring scientific controversy (with Huygens and Hooke): he held the corpuscular thesis, yet in the final Queries (28-31) of the Opticks he publicly registered as unsettled the phenomena the wave thesis could explain (diffraction), writing that the corpuscular thesis has as yet no explanation of diffraction, while the wave thesis has difficulties with rectilinear propagation—the evidence accounts of both theses displayed publicly, the verdict left to future experiments (Young's double-slit a century later, quantum mechanics two centuries later). This is the exemplar of aligning confidence with evidence: the corpuscular conclusion's strength extends only to its evidence (refraction, reflection, dispersion), not half a step beyond. Methodologically: for long-unsettled scientific or business disputes, the right posture is not taking sides but opening the evidence accounts—registering each side's explanatory coverage and difficulties on file, so successors (or new data) can adjudicate automatically.
modes.source_chapter: 《光学》疑问28-31：光的本性两说证据账目与衍射登记；牛顿致 Huygens 通信（1672-1678）对波动说的让步表述；《第三次信件回复》对衍射现象的登记
modes.key_quote_zh: 微粒说对折射与色散已有解释，对衍射尚无；波动说对直线传播尚有困难——两说的账目都摆在案上，裁决留给未来。
modes.key_quote_en: The corpuscular thesis explains refraction and dispersion but not yet diffraction; the wave thesis has difficulties with rectilinear propagation—both accounts lie open on the table; the verdict is left to the future.
process_zh: 为每个竞争立场登记证据账目：能解释什么、解释不了什么、附加困难是什么
给自己的立场定界：结论强度只到证据所及，明确写明本立场尚无解释的现象
登记未决问题为公开疑问：以疑问形式（Queries）保留双方解释，不关闭讨论
写明裁决条件：何种实验/数据出现时，账目将如何自动倾斜（区分力判据）
process_en: Register evidence accounts for each rival position: what it explains, what it cannot, what附加 difficulties it bears
Bound your own position: conclusion strength extends only to your evidence; explicitly state the phenomena your position cannot yet explain
Register unsettled questions as open queries: keep both explanations in question form (Queries), never closing the discussion
State the adjudication conditions: when what experiment/data arrives, how the accounts will automatically tilt (discriminative criteria)
representative_cases_zh: 疑问29-31：牛顿把衍射（Grimaldi 现象）登记为微粒说未解——公开自己的薄弱面
《第三次信件回复》：承认波动说对干涉条纹的初步解释力——对方的强面也登记
百年裁决链：Young 双缝（1801）→ Fresnel 数学化（1818）→ 量子力学波粒二象（1927）——账目最终由新证据自动清算
反例警示：胡克以 microscope 权威强推波动说、牛顿以会长权力压制波动说（学会会刊拒绝波动论文）——权力介入使账目清算延迟一个世纪
representative_cases_en: Queries 29-31: Newton registered diffraction (the Grimaldi phenomenon) as unsolved by the corpuscular thesis—publicly showing his own weak side
The Reply to the Third Letter: acknowledged the wave thesis's initial explanatory power over interference fringes—the opponent's strong side also registered
The century-long adjudication chain: Young's double slit (1801)→Fresnel's mathematization (1818)→quantum wave-particle duality (1927)—the accounts finally settled automatically by new evidence

Cautionary case: Hooke forced the wave thesis with microscope authority; Newton suppressed it with presidential power (the Society's journal refusing wave papers)—power's intervention delayed the account settlement by a century
modern_applications_zh: 技术路线评审：把两派路线的解释覆盖面登记为公开文档，写明各自的未解现象
投资决策：对长期未决的市场争论（如某技术成熟度）登记证据账目而非站队
学术写作：对自己立场的反常数据公开登记，写明何种证据将改变结论
组织决策：对两派方案登记各自困难与附加成本，以区分力判据预设裁决节点
modern_applications_en: Technology-route review: register both routes' explanatory coverage as open documents, stating each one's unsolved phenomena
Investment decisions: for long-unsettled market disputes (e.g., a technology's maturity), register evidence accounts rather than taking sides
Academic writing: publicly register anomalous data for your own position, stating what evidence would change the conclusion
Organizational decisions: register both proposals' difficulties and附加 costs, presetting adjudication nodes with discriminative criteria

modes.domain_zh: 制度权力的越界诊断/科学制度中的争胜成本审计
modes.domain_en: Diagnosing Institutional Power Overreach / Auditing Rivalry Costs within Scientific Institutions
modes.definition_zh: 牛顿晚年以皇家学会会长与铸币厂厂长的权力做了两件损害科学制度的事：与莱布尼茨的微积分优先权战争（操纵学会委员会调查、以学会名义发布《Commercium Epistolicum》指控莱布尼茨剽窃、主导 Royal Society 会刊拒绝对方论文）；铸币厂任内把造假者送上绞架（28 人处死）并动用密探网络。他是自己发明的纪律（假说悬置、证据账目公开）的最大违反者——会长权力使证据账目无法公开清算，波动说论文被拒使光的本性之争延迟百年。体系的天才与权力的越界同栖一身：他晚年自省时销毁部分肖像与手稿，但制度的损害已经发生。方法上这意味着：当方法论者同时握有制度权力时，必须审计权力的越界成本——个人争胜在制度内的清算价（延迟裁决、扭曲账目、吓退异见）远高于表面的胜负。
modes.definition_en: In his later years Newton, wielding the powers of President of the Royal Society and Master of the Mint, did two things damaging the institutions of science: the priority war with Leibniz over calculus (manipulating a Society committee investigation, publishing the Commercium Epistolicum accusing Leibniz of plagiarism in the Society's name, and dominating the Society's journal to refuse his rival's papers); and at the Mint sending counterfeiters to the gallows (28 executed) with an informant network. He was the greatest violator of his own invented disciplines (hypothesis suspension, open evidence accounts)—presidential power made the evidence accounts impossible to settle publicly, and the refusal of wave-theory papers delayed the nature-of-light dispute a century. The genius of the system and the overreach of power lived in one body: in self-examination he destroyed some portraits and manuscripts, but the institutional damage was already done. Methodologically: when a methodologist simultaneously holds institutional power, the overreach cost of that power must be audited—the settlement price of personal rivalry within institutions (delayed adjudication, distorted accounts, frightened dissent) far exceeds the surface win or loss.
modes.source_chapter: 《Commercium Epistolicum》(1712/1713) 与 Royal Society 调查委员会报告（牛顿起草）；《Philosophical Transactions》拒稿记录与《报告》(Report, 1714)；Westfall《Never at Rest》铸币厂档案与肖像销毁记载
modes.key_quote_zh: 会长权力使证据账目无法公开清算——个人争胜在制度内的清算价，远高于表面的胜负。
modes.key_quote_en: Presidential power made the evidence accounts impossible to settle publicly—the settlement price of personal rivalry within institutions far exceeds the surface win or loss.
process_zh: 盘点自身握有的制度权力：会刊审稿权、调查委员会召集权、名誉授予权、执法庭权
识别权力的越界用途：把方法论纪律（账目公开、悬置裁决）用在对手身上之外的权力行使全部标记
审计越界的清算成本：裁决延迟、账目扭曲、异见退出各值多少（波动说延迟百年）
设立反向护栏：以书面规则约束自身权力的行使（如审稿回避、调查委员会独立性），使制度不依赖握权者的自省
process_en: Inventory the institutional power you hold: journal review power, committee convocation power, honor-granting power, judicial power
Identify the overreach uses of power: mark all exercises of power beyond applying your own methodological disciplines (open accounts, suspended verdicts) to yourself as well as rivals
Audit the settlement cost of overreach: how much each of delayed adjudication, distorted accounts, and withdrawing dissent is worth (the wave thesis delayed a century)
Establish reverse guardrails: bind your own power with written rules (review recusal, committee independence), so the institution does not depend on the power-holder's self-examination
representative_cases_zh: 《Commercium Epistolicum》：牛顿起草学会委员会报告指控莱布尼茨剽窃——调查者与被调查同盟的权力越界
会刊拒稿：波动说论文在牛顿会长期内被拒——光的本性之争延迟百年（账目无法清算的直接代价）
铸币厂绞架与密探网络：28 人处死——治安权力的行使无人审计，成为其传记中最暗的章节
反例警示（对照）：莱布尼茨同样争胜但无制度权力——双方争胜成本不对称，握权方的越界成本（制度公信力）才是最大损失
representative_cases_en: The Commercium Epistolicum: Newton drafted the Society committee's report accusing Leibniz of plagiarism—the investigator aligned with a party in the dispute, institutional power overreached
Journal refusals: wave-theory papers refused during Newton's presidency—the nature-of-light dispute delayed a century (the direct cost of unshakable accounts)
The Mint's gallows and informant network: 28 executed—an exercise of policing power no one audited, the darkest chapter of his biography

Cautionary contrast: Leibniz rivaled equally but held no institutional power—the rivalry costs were asymmetric, and the overreach cost of the power-holding side (institutional credibility) was the greatest loss

平台治理：平台规则对自家业务与竞争对手业务的统一审计标准
组织晋升：握有晋升权的管理者对自己派系候选人的权力越界审计
modern_applications_en: Open-source governance: written recusal rules (review, voting, merge power) for maintainers who are a party to the dispute
Academic review: conflict-of-interest declaration and recusal when reviewers are both judge and athlete
Platform governance: unified audit standards for a platform's own businesses and its competitors' businesses
Organizational promotion: power-overreach audits for managers holding promotion power over their own faction's candidates
